columns.entity_id: gn:<geonameid>; exact retained entity foreign key
columns.record_kind: name, abbreviation, phonetic, postal_code, link, wikidata_id, iata, icao, or faac, unlocode, transport_canada_id
columns.language: Original GeoNames language or non-language tag; empty remains undetermined
columns.name: Original alternate name or non-language value
columns.is_preferred: Original 1 or empty; GeoNames preferred flag, not independent legal verification

notes: English labels require en or en-* source tags.
Source country language-code metadata is not proof of legal official/native status.
Postal projection is duplicate subset, not additional alternate rows.
All ten raw alternateNamesV2 fields are retained; language tags are never inferred from ASCII.
